about.title: Bridging the Gap Between Farmers and Markets
about.description: UmuhinzinLink is Rwanda's first comprehensive digital agriculture platform, designed specifically for smallholder farmers. We combine cutting-edge technology with deep understanding of local farming practices to create sustainable solutions.

marketAccess.description: Direct connection to buyers and fair pricing
